senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; צבא to join, follow, v. צָוָה a. צָבַת) service; army, host.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:9">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>שלשה צבאים הן צ׳ לשמים וכ׳</he> there are three kinds of services, there is a service for heaven and earth (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 2:1">Gen. II, 1</cite>); <he>צ׳ לתלמידים</he> there is a service for students (ref. to <cite ref="Job 14:14">Job XIV, 14</cite>); <he>צ׳ ליסורים</he> a service (message) for sufferings (ref. to ib. VII, . Ib. <he>זכה צ׳ לו אם לאו צ׳ עליו</he> if he is favored, a host (of divine powers) is for him; if not, a host (of hostile forces) is against him.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:7:1">Cant. R. to II, 7</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="R00021"><he>צבאות</he></cite>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:7:1">ib.</cite>) <he>בצ׳ של מעלה ובצ׳ של מטה</he> by the host above (the angels) and by the host below (humanity).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:7:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אם תשמרו … כצ׳ של מעלה וכ׳</he> if you guard mine oath, I will make you resemble the host above; if not, I will make you resemble the host below (the animals).

Keth. 3ᵇ דאמרי שר צ׳ בא לעיר it was said, a (Roman) general is coming to the place (and will seize things for his maintenance); a. fr.—Pl. צְבָאִים; (fem.) צְבָאוֹת. Gen. R. l. c., v. supra. Ib. הרבה צ׳ מינה וכ׳ the Lord has appointed many hosts (messengers) to revenge the wrongs &c. Cant. R. l. c. בשתי צ׳ וכ׳ he adjured them by the two hosts (v. supra). Ib. בצ׳ … שעשו צביוני וכ׳ ‘by the hosts’, that means the patriarchs who did my will &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:26">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>והם צִבְאוֹתַי</he> and they (the Israelites) are my hosts.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:26">Ib.</cite> <he>שהם היו צִבְאוֹתָיו וכ׳</he> they were his hosts, and he wanted to count them &c.
Ib. כך צ׳ יש לי בעולמי וכ׳ so and so many troops have I that do my will; a. fr.—(אלהים) ה׳ צבאות the Lord of Hosts.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 5:14">Targ. Jer. V, 14</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:4">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite>.—[<he>צְבָאִים</he>, pl. of <cite ref="R00035"><he>צְבִי</he></cite>, q. v.]
